title: Use Actionable Error Messages to Unblock Users

chapters.title: Improved error handling and actionable errors

features.name: Actionable error messages
features.description: Improved error handling that provides actionable errors at the field level, allowing users to unblock themselves through recommended actions such as refreshing the page or accepting suggested fixes.

features.name: Onboarding framework
features.description: A framework designed to remove friction and avoid blocking users from having a successful start with Business Central.
